Question:
For each real number \(x,\) let \([x]\) be the largest integer not exceeding \(x\) (i.e., the integer \(n\) such that \(n\le x\lt n+1\)). Which of the following statements is (are) true?

\(\mathrm{I}.\) \([x+1]=[x]+1\) for all \(x\)

\(\mathrm{II}.\) \([x+y]=[x]+[y]\) for all \(x\) and \(y\)

\(\mathrm{III}.\) \([xy]=[x][y]\) for all \(x\) and \(y\)
